answer: A Documentation page merged by two maintainers backed by a refundable deposit makes identity cost real work: the documentation page is reviewed line by line, the refundable deposit is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so a Sybil farm must produce genuine, reviewed output for every fake account it wants. Reviewers look for the lantern that does not belong: work with no substance behind it. The violet marks the start and the vine the end, yet the claim is checked again at both points.
